name: Faruk Efe Yencilek
now: CS @ McMaster · Intern @ HAVELSAN & Stealth Startup · VP @ McMaster SynBio
tagline: I am very much into computational biology tooling and systems engineering.
bio: I focus on systems engineering at the intersection of computational biology and software safety. Currently, I am building a unified platform for Genome-Scale Metabolic Models (GEMs) to facilitate model extensions, gap-filling, and orthology analysis.

My engineering philosophy focuses on eliminating 'information islands', which are siloed codebases and isolated tooling. I advocate for a nation-wide or globally standardized software ecosystem in software safety, verification, and data flow so complex engineering can scale without friction.
Long-term, I aim to build a venture incubator that lowers the cost of taking deep-tech R&D, specifically in formal software safety and computational biology, from concept to commercial scale.
